job.job_description:
Junior AI Developer

Technology

Full Time

Remote

Experience

1-3 years of experience in AI/ML development, with a focus on NLP and LLMs

Qualification

Bachelor s degree

Offered Salary

Based on experience

We are seeking a Junior AI Developer to build and optimize LLM-based applications for data extraction, XPath generation, and autonomous AI agents. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with large language models, expertise in Python, and a passion for solving AI-driven challenges in an agile environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop and deploy LLM-based applications for data extraction, XPath generation, and autonomous AI agents.
Engage in prompt engineering, model fine tuning, and rapid prototyping to enhance AI performance.
Integrate LLM functionalities into existing systems using APIs.
Stay updated with the latest advancements in LLMs and AI to propose innovative solutions.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement AI-driven automation.
Required Skills Qualifications:
1-3 years of experience in AI/ML development, with a focus on NLP and LLMs.
Hands-on experience with large language models (e.g., Openai, Claude, Gemini, Deepseek), including prompt engineering and fine tuning.
Proficiency in Python and familiarity with ML/NLP frameworks such as Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, TensorFlow.
Experience with agentic frameworks like Langgraph and CrewAI.
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in an exploratory, agile environment.
Familiarity with API integration and deployment of AI models in production Environments.
Nice-to-Have Skills:
Knowledge of web scraping, data parsing, or autonomous agents.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Understanding of vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) techniques.
Other Infrastructure Requirements

Since this is a completely work-from-home position, you will also require the following

High-speed internet connectivity for video calls and efficient work.
Capable business-grade computer (e.g., modern processor, 8 GB+ of RAM, and no other obstacles to interrupted efficient work).
Headphones with clear audio quality.
Stable power connection and backups in case of internet/power failure.
